title: Road to a bigger back
summary: He assesses his back: thick rather than wide due to short clavicles, with lagging upper traps, rear delts and lat width. Those three become his priorities to build the contour of his physique; his lower back is already strong but still trained for injury prevention.

claims.claim: Because he has short clavicles, his back is very thick but not very wide.
He agrees with a commenter who said his physique lacks traps and rear delts.
His main hypertrophy priority is the contour of the physique, the muscles around the outline of the back.
His mid traps are big but his upper traps are lacking, visible even from the front when shrugging.
Rear delts matter for the back double biceps: they should pop alongside the arm; if they lag, the biceps peak sticks out far beyond them.
His lats lack width and thickness, especially in the lower portion.
His three back goals are upper traps, rear delts and lats, with progress photos compared after 6-8 months.
His lower back is already big, but he will not neglect it because a strong lower back is very important for injury prevention.
